name: ccxt
description: Official CCXT plugins for Claude: ccxt connects to the hosted public market-data server, ccxt-local runs the CCXT MCP server on your computer for accounts and opt-in trading. Each bundles its usage skill.

plugins.name: ccxt
plugins.description: The hosted CCXT MCP server (https://docs.ccxt.com/mcp) plus a usage skill — read-only public market data and interactive charts from major crypto exchanges. No install, no API keys.

plugins.name: ccxt-local
plugins.description: The CCXT MCP server running on your computer (npx -y ccxt-mcp), plus its usage skill: market data, balances and opt-in trading across 100+ crypto exchanges and prediction markets, with keys kept local.
